Fields are absent when da_file_name is not set.

summary: Added da_file_name_stem, da_tools_list, da_tools_json computed convenience fields to buildContext() in src/builders/persona-builder.ts. da_file_name_stem: derived from da_file_name by stripping .md suffix, only set when da_file_name is a string and da_file_name_stem is not already in merged context. da_tools_list/da_tools_json: serialized from da_tools array when present, falling back to tools; only emitted when da_file_name is set (keeping the fields absent for personas without a deep-agents output file).

Created tests/builders/da-computed-fields.test.ts with 7 tests covering all 4 acceptance criteria: stem derivation (with and without .md), tools fallback, YAML override (not overwritten), and fields absent when da_file_name is missing.
All 291 tests pass. TypeScript type check clean.

comments.note: The da_tools_list / da_tools_json block is gated on `da_file_name` presence (mirroring the AC that fields are absent without da_file_name), but the pattern diverges from cc_tools_list / cc_tools_json which are always emitted unconditionally. A note in a comment explaining the intentional asymmetry would avoid future confusion.

The `tools` variable resolved in buildContext() is always re-declared near the top of the derived-fields block. Extracting it once (already done) is good, but the da_tools fallback silently converts a missing `da_tools` field to the `tools` array. This matches the cc_tools pattern exactly and is consistent.
